function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the identity of the person on the call against the account on file. Must be called and must return verified:true before any debt/account information is disclosed.

account_id.description: The Kapture Finance account ID associated with this call, e.g. 'ACC-88392'.

verification_code.description: The value provided by the customer to verify identity — either the last 4 digits of their PAN, or their birth year (e.g. '1234' or '1995').

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Records a customer's committed payment date and amount after they agree to pay their overdue balance.

ptp_date.description: The date the customer has committed to pay, in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

amount.description: The amount, in INR, the customer has committed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Dispatches a payment link to the verified customer via the specified channel, after a Promise-to-Pay has been logged.

channel.description: The channel through which to send the payment link.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes the call/case to a human agent or grievance desk, used for hardship claims or disputes that require human judgment.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome/disposition of the call. Must be called exactly once before the call ends, regardless of which branch the conversation took.

status.description: The final disposition status of the call.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes providing additional context about the disposition.
